name: B1 lift lobby
purpose: B1 arrival: the lift and Spiral Stair let guests out into a low, warm ring of stone around a glowing bronze drum; the air turns humid, mist spills in from two corridor mouths, and they choose a way (west to the Mirror and steam, south-east to the slide and treatments).

ceiling_profile.note: Low carved ring vault between the lift drum (r 8) and the outer wall (r 12.5): 4.5 m at the drum, 3.7 m at the wall. Keeps B1's compressed register before the corridors.

spurs.note: North half of the ring (benches, rill): walkable loop, not the through-route.

hero.why: The lobby is a ring around B1's only fixed vertical link. The graybox lift car glows warm inside the open spiral well and the well has a balustrade; that lit car is what both corridor mouths frame and the landmark every B1 route returns to.

anchored.why: The first thing read on stepping off the Spiral Stair: on the outer wall straight ahead of the stair door (bearing 308).
Quiet north half: wait for companions facing the drum.
Second bench beside the rill, angled so the two are not a row.
Dark silhouette by the rill between the two benches.
Bamboo spout and basin where the lobby rill rises; the only water sound in the lobby. Kept west of the clipped NE wall.

Low lamps on the floor at the well balustrade, in pairs either side of the stair landing gap (308) and the lift bridge (128), plus a pool on the south and north arcs; dark gaps between. The glowing lift car stays brightest.

water.note: Narrow rill along the outer wall of the quiet north half, from the basin (bearing 19) west to the corridor pool at the west mouth. Same -20.05 surface as the corridors.

sightlines.see: Stepping off the stair: the west corridor mouth: noren, knee-high mist, niche lanterns doubled in the water; the koi junction's glow 12 m beyond.
Out of the lift and over the bridge: the south-east corridor mouth almost straight ahead, its far bend tinted orange by the lava slot (first hint of the slide).
Returning from the west: the lit drum and its ring of base lights.
Returning from the slide: drum and lantern pools on the outer wall leading round to the west mouth.

concept.match: The round lift drum and carved spiral at the centre of a timber ring with lanterns: at eye level the lit car in the well on the right, the ring curving away left with pools of light and dark gaps.

dressing.why: Edge rocks on the outer wall, so each lantern pool has something to light.

mood.palette: amber lanterns, bronze and glass drum, black wet basalt, a thread of teal rill
mood.mist: None of its own; corridor mist spills in at the two mouths only.

waivers.reason: The lift drum is structural (built by the graybox from layout.json), so it has no hero proxy to sample; it fills the view from every camera here.
The lift is fixed at the E3 cell centre on every level (layout decision); everything else keeps off cell centres.

light_notes: Drum base ring and the glass slots of lift_core carry the hero light (asset emission).
conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
